versions.title: Harbor Authority, Engineering: Inspection note N-4 (shared)
versions.body:
PORT CALDER HARBOR AUTHORITY, ENGINEERING OFFICE
Date: 6 January 2025
Re: North ferry dock, pylon N-4

Routine dive inspection found a vertical crack in pylon N-4, approx. 40 cm, at low-water line. Recommend closure of north dock at the earliest opportunity and replacement of N-4. Adjacent pylon N-5 to be checked.

Uploaded by: unfiltered_docs
